## [1.2.0](https://github.com/JacobPlaysGames/CrimeRadar-Morphe-Patches/releases/tag/v1.2.0) (2026-08-24)

### ✨ Features

* **crimeradar:** Premium Bypass — all subscription checks
* **crimeradar:** Change Package Name — install alongside original
* **crimeradar:** Location Limit Override — unlimited followed locations
* **crimeradar:** Replay Minutes Override — unlimited replay listening time
* **crimeradar:** Telemetry Kill — disables Instabug and Adjust tracking
* **crimeradar:** Remove History Cap — lifts 200-item local reading history limit
* **crimeradar:** Notification Limits Raised — higher per-category push caps
